title: dryopteris aculeata
intro: Dryopteris aculeata, commonly known as needle fern or saw-sedge, is a species of fern in the genus Dryopteris. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae and is native to various parts of the world. The health benefits of Dryopteris aculeata include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as inflammation and fever, due to its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
